text: 穿灰色運動衫配金十字架項鍊
note: grey sweatshirt with white lettering and gold cross pendant on black cord

text: 海浪拍打沙灘退潮留濕沙
note: gentle waves washing across wet sand at low tide

text: 穿灰T恤的年輕人低頭看沙地
note: young man in grey shirt looks right at 11.6s, then lowers his head toward the sand later in S004

text: 穿灰T恤配黑珠鍊金十字架項鍊，站海邊
note: close chest shot of grey T-shirt and black beaded chain with gold cross by the sea

text: 阿嬤的話字卡浮現在海邊潮池與遠方船影上
note: distant ship on the horizon over tidal sandbars as the title card '阿嬤的話' fades in during S009

text: 手轉門把，木門緩緩開啟
note: hand turns the knob and pushes open the wooden bedroom door

text: 手輕放於深色粗糙桌面邊緣，指縫微張
note: right hand rests on the worn dark wooden dresser top with fingers slightly spread

text: 手輕觸深色木桌邊緣，指縫微張
note: left hand touches the front edge of the dark wooden dresser drawer before pulling

text: 抽屜被拉開，露出大圓鐵盒與小罐，鐵盒上寫著「白城堡奶油餅乾」。
note: drawer opens revealing small medicine jars and a round blue White Castle butter-cookie tin

text: 白城堡牛肉餅鐵盒在抽屜內
note: tin is inside the open drawer as hands shift items, but 'White Castle' is mistranslated as burger sliders ('牛肉餅') on this shot

text: 手輕轉鐵盒，露出「白城堡」字樣
note: hands lift and rotate the blue round tin showing the 'WHITE CASTLE' lid

text: 手掀開鐵盒蓋，露出裡面的奶油餅乾。
note: hands lift the tin lid (which illustrates butter cookies), but inside the tin are pill packs and papers rather than cookies

text: 手拿藥片包與鐵盒，盒內紙條列明作息時刻。
note: right hand holds yellow blister pack of pills while left hand holds the tin containing a printed medication schedule sheet

text: 手將紅色平安符綁繩的標籤放進鐵盒，隨即抽手。
note: identifies the red temple amulet ('紅色平安符') inside the tin, though the hand is lifting out the white paper to uncover it rather than placing it in

text: 手握紅色小物，低頭凝視。
note: young man in white T-shirt and cross necklace holds the small red amulet and looks down at it

text: 手握紅包，包有金字龍紋。
note: close-up of palm holding the red temple amulet pouch ('香火袋', described generically as '紅包') embossed with gold characters and dragon border

text: 年輕男子握紅繩，低頭細看。
note: young man holds the red cord of the amulet in his fingers, looking closely
visually accurate profile shot looking right at monitor, automatically held back from audio track by fit gate (avail < spoken)
